title: Emergent BioSolutions Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Second Quarter 2026 Total Revenues of $234.3 million, an improvement of 66% versus prior year Second Quarter 2026 Net Loss of $180.2 million worsening 1,402% versus prior year, largely due to a $191.3 million non-cash impairment charge Second Quarter 2026 Adjusted Net Income of $30.9 million
body_markdown: Second Quarter 2026 Total Revenues of $234.3 million, an improvement of 66% versus prior year Second Quarter 2026 Net Loss of $180.2 million worsening 1,402% versus prior year, largely due to a $191.3 million non-cash impairment charge Second Quarter 2026 Adjusted Net Income of $30.9 million
